# PSC AGM 2026 Motion 9: Examples of Anti-Palestinian Racism

This site provides a machine-readable mirror of Palestine Solidarity Campaign AGM 2026 Motion 9, “Examples of Anti-Palestinian Racism.”

The authoritative source is PSC’s AGM record. This repository is a mirror and retrieval aid.
